**Finding: Compliant (preferred position met) — NONCOMPETE**

The Kubient MSA contains no restrictive covenant binding AP. Key points:

- **§1 (p0001)** affirmatively disclaims exclusivity and preserves AP's freedom to monetise Inventory elsewhere: "Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement... This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties."
- **§2 (p0002)** grants AP a **non-exclusive** licence to the Auction Platform, and applies only "In the event Customer shall utilize Kubient's ad serving technology" — a voluntary-use grant, not a sourcing obligation.
- **§6(a) (p0025)** contains the only Customer-side prohibitions (no third-party access, no reverse engineering, no resale/service bureau of the Service). These are standard licence-scope protections on Vendor's own technology, not field-of-use or line-of-business restrictions on AP, so they are correctly classified outside this rule.
- Searches for compete/competing/competitor, field-of-use, territory, sole source, exclusively through, first look, and minimum volume returned no responsive restriction.

No redline proposed, consistent with the instruction not to flag terms that benefit our party.
